title: Load strategy
subtitle: target_config.cdc_load_strategy decides how data is merged into the target. Pick a tab — only that strategy's parameters are shown.

title: Target · storage & table
subtitle: Physical layout of the target table.

fields.label: target_config.storage_format
fields.hint: iceberg: batch_table only · Iceberg reads elsewhere via UniForm table property
fields.description: Target table format. iceberg is only valid when target_type is batch_table — for every other target type, leave this on delta and add table property enable_iceberg_read_uniformity: true instead.

fields.label: target_config.capture_technical_metadata
fields.description: Transformation flows only. Gates __framework_ingestion_timestamp_utc.

fields.label: partition_columns mode
fields.hint: [] means explicitly unpartitioned, never an error
fields.description: absent omits partition_columns entirely. unpartitioned writes partition_columns: [] — an explicit declaration that table is not partitioned. named writes columns you list.

fields.label: target_config.partition_columns
fields.description: Physical partitioning. Only effective for APPEND and TRUNCATE_AND_LOAD — silently ignored for CDC-dispatched strategies.

fields.label: target_config.liquid_clustering_columns
fields.description: Liquid clustering keys. Only effective for APPEND and TRUNCATE_AND_LOAD. Maximum of 3 columns.

fields.label: target_config.table_properties
fields.description: Delta table properties, added as key-value pairs. Documented keys: log_retention_duration, deleted_file_retention_duration, enable_iceberg_read_uniformity.

fields.label: auto_ttl.timestamp_column
fields.description: Row age reference column (DATE/TIMESTAMP/TIMESTAMP_NTZ). Only valid for APPEND and TRUNCATE_AND_LOAD.

fields.label: auto_ttl.expire_in_days
fields.description: Rows older than this many days are auto-deleted.

title: Target · encrypted columns
subtitle: Each entry encrypts one output column with AES cipher (GCM, CBC, ECB).

fields.label: target_config.encrypted_columns[]
fields.description: Columns to encrypt with AES. The framework records the pre-encryption Spark type as the original_data_type tag -- declare source_data_type to pin what that type must be.

fields.label: column_name
fields.description: Plaintext column on this flow's DataFrame to encrypt.

fields.label: output_column
fields.description: Output column name. Defaults to column_name — set the same name to encrypt in place.

fields.label: mode
fields.description: AES cipher mode. GCM is recommended — it adds a random IV.

fields.label: source_data_type
fields.description: Optional. The column's original Spark type before encryption replaces it with ciphertext binary (e.g. string, decimal(18,2), timestamp). Becomes the Unity Catalog original_data_type tag that a downstream decrypted_columns.cast_to_type is checked against. Leave blank to use the type observed at encryption time; declare it to make a silent source type change fail loudly instead.

title: Target · sink config
subtitle: Required when target_type is sink or external_sink. sink exports only; external_sink writes a governed table and exports.

fields.label: sink_config.format
fields.description: Export format. pgp_zip uses the framework's custom PySpark DataSource.

fields.label: sink_config.path
fields.description: Output directory. Required for delta and pgp_zip.

fields.label: sink_config.write_mode
fields.description: Delta write mode. Currently accepted but inert — @dlt.append_flow always appends.

fields.label: post_export_archive.enabled
fields.description: Enable post-write archiving for pgp_zip exports.

fields.label: post_export_archive.output_zip_path
fields.description: Where the final ZIP is written.

fields.label: pgp_encryption.enabled
fields.description: PGP-encrypt the output archive.

title: Data quality
subtitle: Rules become pipeline expectations. quarantine is a framework extension routing failed rows to a companion table.

fields.label: dq_config.rules[]
fields.description: Expectation definitions.

fields.label: rule_id
fields.description: Unique rule identifier.

fields.label: action
fields.description: warn logs and keeps the row, drop silently removes it, fail aborts the pipeline, quarantine routes it to the quarantine table.

fields.label: expression
fields.description: Boolean Spark SQL expression evaluated per row.

fields.label: dq_config.quarantine_table
fields.description: Quarantine table name. Only created when at least one rule uses action quarantine.

fields.label: dq_config.record_id_column
fields.description: Surfaced as __framework_record_id on quarantined rows for traceability.

title: Governance tags
subtitle: Applied post-deployment via ALTER TABLE SET TAGS.

fields.label: governance_tags.column_tags[]
fields.description: Column governance tags.

fields.label: column
fields.description: Column to tag.

fields.label: tags
fields.description: Key-value tags, e.g. mask: PII, classification: restricted.

fields.label: governance_tags.table_tags
fields.description: Table-level tags, e.g. row_filter: region_restricted, domain: finance.
